privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
sections: The contact form collects your name, email address and whatever you write in the message. Nothing else is asked for and nothing is collected in the background beyond anonymous visit counts.
To reply to you. Messages are kept for as long as the conversation is useful and deleted on request.
Only the site owner. Details are never sold or passed on.
Ask for a copy of what is held about you, or for it to be removed, by writing to the address on the contact page.

terms.title: Terms
sections: The writing and case studies here are offered in good faith and without warranty. Figures in case studies are published with each client's agreement.
Paid work is covered by a separate written agreement that sets out scope, price and dates. Nothing on this site is an offer of work.
Text and images belong to the site owner unless stated otherwise. Quote freely with a link back.
